main_text.p: Gebvefanuftt,Subftantia: & getwin, poffeffio; getwnt idem] Poffeffio,Sax. ȝepinn, ab eorum ȝepinnan fluens, Teuton. ghewinnen, nancifci, acquirere, obtinere, &c. unde noftrum to winne, (verbum) item winning, (nomen.)
Getwitt, Scientia] Hoc Saxon.pitᴞ, & ȝepiᴛᴞ, quorum prius nobis manfit.
Getwitfcopt, Teftimonia] Hoc Sax. ȝepiᴛnyrrȝa, unde noftrum twitnefte, pro teftimonio. Sax. etiam,teftium ftipatio, ȝepiᴛᴞcype.
Gipondt, Patens: nos gapende forte] Anglis gaping', à Saxon.ȝeopnian, aperire. Patens etiam eis opnienoe, & opnizenoe, unde noftratium open, & openting, illo fenfu.

page.notes: Old English glosses are partly illegible in the scan; the Saxon letter forms (ȝ, ᴞ, ᴛ) are approximations of the printed characters. Page is a single text column with a marginal mark "Gl-" at lower right, read as a catchword.
